text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code easier to read and understand. This is important because clean, readable code helps teams work faster and make fewer mistakes. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which is the extra work that builds up when code is written quickly without proper planning. By regularly cleaning up their code, developers keep their projects healthy and easier to maintain over time. Good refactoring does not add new features or fix bugs; it simply makes the code better organized and simpler to work with in the future.
